hypothesis: A direct activity-versus-relation preference can decide where to spend a fixed non-temporal probability budget. The two-edge margin study had .55154 on its first 13 later evaluation questions versus .55392 with raw contrasts and .59779 for always choosing relation. Three raw direct-edge reference recoveries and their histories are known; their new weaker-action repair outcomes have not been used to select this rule. The two later histories are exposed and all other formal gates stay locked.
training: Use every registered early temporal-prefix direct-edge window after the complete 12-window activity/relationship repair census. A second, separately scored version adds all 12 activity-prefix windows only after its complete audit. Keep all unmatched windows in coverage. For each matched window compute whole-window relation-minus-activity F1 and sum only confirmed direct-edge credit divided by that same question count. Never add temporal-versus-other labels to the direct target. Exclude entire target histories before fitting. Fit raw ridge against whole-window effect and its predeclared soft-margin version against direct credit using the same normalization and penalty convention as three_skill_margin. Features are intercept, frozen whole-source relation affinity divided by two, and the median paired-minus-single own-vs-distractor source margin (geometry column 5), standardized on raw donors with .02 SD floor and clipped to +/-3. Both-prefix model additionally includes actual preceding action centered to +/-1. Equal history/source/background weights. Rotate direct credit cyclically within donor history and preceding action.
allocation: Take the temporal probability from the registered three-skill raw-return mixture at the exact measured decision. Preserve that probability across every direct-edge ablation. For the remaining mass use q = .20 times the checkpoint's conditional relationship probability among activity and relation plus .80 times sigmoid(predicted relation-minus-activity effect/.05). Compare raw, verified, rotated, prior three-skill raw and credit, and native. Report a conditional matched-rate control that preserves the question-weighted non-temporal budget and relation mass across the comparison population. Credit can only redistribute mass between relation and activity. Check that the exact F1 difference from raw equals the change in relationship probability times the directly measured relation-minus-activity F1 for every question.
gates: Use the same 25/209 protocol, exact measured source checks, held-history fitting, prior exposure, coverage, four-history, native +.02 and strict/raw promotion criteria as the three-skill margin study. Also beat both prior three-skill actors and the conditional matched-rate control. Both-prefix extension additionally compares to the time-prefix-only forecast on the same outcomes. No independent test access before gates.
